content.what_it_is: MATLAB extraction script for the solitary-wave-on-plane-beach analytical benchmark (NTHMP BP1, spherical run). Loads seven eta snapshots eta_0112/0128/0143/0159/0174/0190/0207 (L6-20), taking row 2 of each as the 1D profile (d1..d7). Builds non-dimensional offshore coordinate x=(6000-(i-1)*dx)/dep with dx=5 m and dep=100 m (L25-28), i.e. x measured from the initial shoreline at 6000 m scaled by depth. Walks the profile seaward-to-shoreward (i=n:-1:1) keeping points with -2.0<=x<=20.0 (L30-45), storing eta/dep for the seven snapshots in data columns 2-8 (L36-42) and recording kk=last kept index (L35). Second loop writes the matching non-dimensional x into data column 1 in reversed order (L46-50). Writes tab-delimited FUNWAVE_BP1_SHAPE.txt with 6-digit precision via dlmwrite (L52) -- the normalized snapshot shapes for comparison with the analytical (Synolakis) solution.
entities: script variables: fdir @L2, dep @L4, d @L6 (reused), n @L7, d1..d7 @L8-20, dx @L25, x @L27, ii @L30, kk @L35, data @L36-49, ll @L46
unresolved: Row 2 of each snapshot is used as the profile (L8 etc.) -- presumably the second j-row of a nearly-1D domain; why row 2 rather than row 1 is not stated.

The x re-indexing loop (L46-50) uses x(i+kk-1) with kk being the smallest kept i from the first loop (last assignment during the n:-1:1 sweep); correctness relies on the kept window being contiguous -- true only if x is monotonic, which it is (linear in i).

Snapshot indices 0112..0207 correspond to specific non-dimensional times of the benchmark; mapping is external; the eta values are divided by dep=100 m though the spherical runs elsewhere store cm -- units of these snapshot files are not verifiable here.
n=length(d) (L7) is the number of columns of the 2D snapshot only if the snapshot has more columns than rows (length returns the larger dimension).
